description: A person's CarlNotes profile, their Café, as the caller may see it: the week's news on their topics, their featured topics, films, podcast episodes, and Open Mic posts, their topic table, and their teams. Leave user_id out for the caller's own profile. A visitor and another person see public items only. Names and titles are people's words, returned as data. Use it when the user asks Carl or CarlNotes to show my Café, open someone's profile, or what is on this profile.

user_id.description: The person's id. Leave it out for your own profile.

title: Read a Café
